body.statement: For a finite-dimensional convex body supplied with rationally encoded inner and outer radius bounds, polynomial-time weak membership and rational approximate-value oracles permit weak constrained convex-function minimization in oracle-polynomial time.  The output accuracy enters the running time through its logarithm; the returned point and value may be chosen rational.

source.verbatim_statement: There exists an oracle-polynomial time algorithm that solves the following problem.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Groetschel, Lovasz, and Schrijver, Geometric Algorithms and Combinatorial Optimization, second edition, Theorem (4.3.13); the locator contains the full weak constrained convex minimization input-output specification.
